8.name: Splintered Secrets

1.name: Recuperative Treatise
1.description:
Etch a series of runes onto your weapon that pulse with power once every |cffffff5|r seconds. Each pulse enhances your Arcanist skills, and striking an enemy with one deals an additional |cffffff3642|r Magic Damage, restores |cffffff600|r Magicka and Stamina, and generates Crux if you have none.

While slotted on either ability bar, gain Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff20|r%.

2.name: Cephaliarch's Flail
2.description:
Infuse your arm with abyssal magic to form tentacles that lash out at your foes dealing |cffffff6082|r Physical Damage and generating Crux. Enemies are immobilized for |cffffff3|r seconds and marked with Abyssal Ink for |cffffff20|r seconds.

If an enemy is hit, you for heal for |cffffff3324|r Health, once per cast.

You deal |cffffff5|r% increased damage to enemies drenched in Abyssal Ink.

3.name: Pragmatic Fatecarver
3.description:
Channel a beam of energy in front of you for up to |cffffff4|r seconds, dealing |cffffff2757|r Magic Damage every |cffffff0.3|r seconds to up to 6 enemies. While channeling, you also gain a damage shield that absorbs up to |cffffff9639|r damage and grants interrupt immunity.

Casting Pragmatic Fatecarver consumes all Crux and increases damage done by |cffffff33|r%, and decreases cost by |cffffff16|r% per Crux spent.

This ability is considered direct damage.

4.name: Killer's Blade
4.description:
Thrust a caustic blade with lethal precision to stab an enemy, dealing |cffffff3642|r Disease Damage. Deals up to |cffffff400|r% more damage to enemies with less than |cffffff50|r% Health.

Heals you for |cffffff7964|r if the enemy dies within |cffffff2|r seconds of being struck.

5.name: Echoing Vigor
5.description: Let loose a battle cry, instilling you and your allies with resolve and healing for |cffffff17343|r Health over |cffffff16|r seconds.

6.name: The Tide King's Gaze
6.description:
Tear open the fabric of the Aurbis to unleash a scion of Hermaeus Mora. This being casts forth a beam that rends asunder reality for |cffffff8|r seconds that deals |cffffff3612|r Magic Damage to enemies within 5 meters every |cffffff0.5|r seconds. 

The scion's beam automatically follows the initial target, and hunts for a new one within 8 meters if it is slain.

1.name: Stampede
1.description:
Launch across the earth and smash an enemy, dealing |cffffff4596|r Physical Damage to them and all nearby enemies. This attack is always a Critical Strike.

After reaching your target, you sunder the ground beneath you, dealing |cffffff1054|r Physical Damage to all enemies in the area every |cffffff1|r second for |cffffff15|r seconds.

2.name: Rune of Displacement
2.description:
Devise a discharging rune under an enemy. After |cffffff2|r seconds the rune pulses, pulling in foes between 2 to 10 meters and etching them with scrawled glyphs that deal |cffffff15820|r Magic Damage over |cffffff18|r seconds.

An ally near the initial target can activate the Runebreak synergy, dealing |cffffff8899|r Frost Damage to enemies within 7 meters.

3.name: Recuperative Treatise
3.description:
Etch a series of runes onto your weapon that pulse with power once every |cffffff5|r seconds. Each pulse enhances your Arcanist skills, and striking an enemy with one deals an additional |cffffff3830|r Magic Damage, restores |cffffff600|r Magicka and Stamina, and generates Crux if you have none.

While slotted on either ability bar, gain Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff20|r%.

4.name: Merciless Resolve
4.description:
When slotted on either bar, gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by |cffffff12|r%.

Your Light and Heavy Attacks now generate a stack of Merciless Resolve, up to |cffffff10|r times. Fully-charged Heavy Attacks grant two stacks.

When at |cffffff5|r or more stacks, you can consume |cffffff5|r to fire a spectral arrow to deal |cffffff15668|r Magic Damage and heal for |cffffff54|r% of the damage dealt, if you are in melee range.

5.name: Concealed Weapon
5.description:
Slash an enemy, dealing |cffffff8426|r Magic Damage. 

If you strike an enemy from their flank you set them Off Balance.

When you leave Sneak or invisibility while in combat, increase your damage done with this ability by |cffffff10|r% for |cffffff15|r seconds.

While slotted on either bar, you gain Minor Expedition, increasing your Movement Speed by |cffffff15|r%.

6.name: Soul Harvest
6.description:
Ravage an enemy with a spinning attack, dealing |cffffff12257|r Magic Damage and increasing your damage against them by |cffffff20|r% for |cffffff8|r seconds.

Also afflicts the enemy with Major Defile, reducing their healing received and damage shield strength by |cffffff12|r%.

While slotted on either bar, any time you kill an enemy you gain |cffffff10|r Ultimate.
